findings.finding: Front F2 tasks are executed by subagents dispatched by a coordinator that does not exist until the operator elects one, yet no F2 task says it waits for that election.
findings.evidence: roles[0].who: "none until then" / roles[2].who: "subagents dispatched by the coordinator" / fronts[1].tasks[1].executor: "Sonnet implementation subagent against the approved bridge" / situation.owed_by_operator[3]: "Confirm who coordinates now"
findings.what_changes_if_true: F2 cannot start at the time the plan implies, so the winner's C3 advantage over option A shrinks.

findings.finding: The proof of T1.2 counts the word 'owed' on the page, which passes whether or not the four operator items were actually put as questions.
findings.what_changes_if_true: T1.2 can be marked done while an owed item is missing from the gate.

findings.finding: The proof of T1.1 and the condition of M1 accept any NOTE as the last chain line, so they do not check that the NOTE records the missing link, the MD5 divergence and register r3.
findings.what_changes_if_true: M1 can be declared reached with an unrelated NOTE.

findings.finding: The proof of T2.4 checks a file writes.sha256 that no task produces, and the M2 condition and T2.2 proof name orbit.db and tests/ without saying under which root, so neither has a defined measuring step.
findings.evidence: fronts[1].tasks[3].proof: "sha256sum -c writes.sha256" / done_when[1].condition: "sqlite3 orbit.db 'select count(*) from observations'"
findings.what_changes_if_true: The hash rule and the M2 milestone cannot be checked by a command as written.
